comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and Micron (MU) disclose specific cash dividend payments and governance structures in Item 8. NVDA reports total cash dividends paid of $395 million in fiscal 2024, subject to Board determination. Micron details a consistent quarterly dividend structure, paying $0.115 per share in each quarter of 2024, with similar Board oversight for declarations. Both companies affirm the Board's role in continuing the programs, though NVDA provides aggregate dollar amounts while Micron provides per-share metrics and specific payment dates.

sentences.text: During fiscal years 2024, 2023, and 2022, we paid $395 million, $398 million, and $399 million in cash dividends to our shareholders, respectively.

Our cash dividend program and the payment of future cash dividends under that program are subject to our Board of Directors' continuing determination that the dividend program and the declaration of dividends thereunder are in the best interests of our shareholders.
In each quarter of 2024, we declared and paid dividends of $0.115 per share.

On September 25, 2024, our Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of $0.115 per share, payable in cash on October 23, 2024, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on October 7, 2024.
